name: Seshiro
description: Suzue's son, who became Broodmaster; his children led the Matsu and Sakura tribes.

description_citations.text: "Snake". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Suzue seeks out the budoka Dosan and raises her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.
timeline.quote: The orochi Suzue sought out the budoka Dosan , and raised her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seshiro urges making friends in times of strife.
timeline.quote: In times of strife, the foolish make a fist while the wise make a friend.

citation.text: Seshiro's Living Legacy (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Kaseto calls Seshiro a revered ancestor.
relations.quote: Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs.

citation.text: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A revered orochi ancestor who gave wisdom.
